description: Forward-compat example: heterogeneous Chipyard config with mixed core types. XPU-RT picks per-dispatch hardware_target from this registry; the runtime maps each kind to its own worker queue. Today's runtime collapses everything to one pthreadpool — only valid descriptors below are honored when this scaffolding lights up.

cores.name: boom0
cores.description: Out-of-order BOOM — best for branchy / control-heavy dispatches.

cores.name: rvv0
cores.description: Vector-extension hart — preferred for parallel linear/conv kernels.

cores.name: gemmini0
cores.description: Gemmini systolic-array accelerator — only matmul/conv at int8.
